cmd: ls /app && cat /etc/os-release | head -5 && which gcc g++ make wget curl
echo "---"; which gcc; which g++; which make; which curl; which cc; echo "---"; ls /app/deps/
curl -s --max-time 30 http://archive.debian.org/debian/pool/main/p/povray/ | grep -oE 'href="[^"]+"' | sed 's/href=//;s/"//g' | grep -v '^\.\.' | grep -vE 'deb$|dsc$|debian.tar' | head -40

curl -sL --max-time 30 https://www.povray.org/download/versions.html -o /tmp/versions.html; grep -oE 'href="[^"]+"' /tmp/versions.html | grep -iE '2\.2|2\.1' | head; echo ===; curl -s --max-time 30 http://archive.debian.org/debian/dists/bo/main/source/p/ | grep -oE 'href="[^"]+"' | head -20

curl -s --max-time 20 http://ftp.povray.org/pub/povray/ | grep -oE 'href="[^"]+"' | head -20; echo ===SF===; curl -s --max-time 20 "https://sourceforge.net/projects/povray/files/" -o /tmp/sf.html; wc -c /tmp/sf.html; grep -oE 'files/[^"]+' /tmp/sf.html | head -20

cat /tmp/sf.html; echo; echo ===BO===; curl -s --max-time 20 http://archive.debian.org/debian/dists/bo/ | grep -oE 'href="[^"]+"' | head; echo ===BO-P===; curl -s --max-time 20 "http://archive.debian.org/debian/dists/bo/main/source/p/" | grep -oE 'href="[^"]+"' | head -30

curl -s --max-time 20 "http://archive.debian.org/debian/dists/bo/main/" | grep -oE 'href="[^"]+"' | head; echo ===; curl -s --max-time 20 "http://archive.debian.org/debian/dists/bo/main/binary-i386/p/" | grep -oE 'href="[^"]+"' | grep -i pov | head

curl -s --max-time 20 "http://archive.debian.org/debian/dists/bo/main/" | grep -oE 'href="[^"]+"' | tail -12; echo ===SRC===; curl -s --max-time 20 "http://archive.debian.org/debian/dists/bo/main/source/" | grep -oE 'href="[^"]+"' | head -12
for d in graphics misc editors; do echo "== $d =="; curl -s --max-time 20 "http://archive.debian.org/debian/dists/bo/main/source/$d/" | grep -oiE 'href="[^"]*pov[^"]*"'; done

mkdir -p /app/src && cd /app/src && curl -s --max-time 60 "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org*&filter=original:.*povray-2\.2.*&fl=original,timestamp,statuscode&collapse=urlkey&limit=300" > cdx.txt; wc -l cdx.txt; grep -iE 'tar|zip' cdx.txt | head -30
cd /app/src && awk '{print $1}' cdx.txt | sed 's/&download=1.*//' | sort -u | head -40
cd /app/src && awk '{print $1, $3}' cdx.txt | sed 's/&raw=1.*//; s/&download=1//; s/&nohtml=1//; s/&binary=1//' | sort -u | awk '$2==200' | head -30
cd /app/src && grep -E 'Official-2.2-Source-distribution|povray-2.2_src_all' cdx.txt | awk '{print $1, $2, $3}' | sort -u | head -20
cd /app/src && curl -sL --max-time 120 -o povray-2.2.tgz "http://www.povray.org/misc/oldversion.php?file=Official-2.2-Source-distribution/povray-2.2.tgz" ; ls -la povray-2.2.tgz; file povray-2.2.tgz

cd /app/src && head -c 300 povray-2.2.tgz; echo; echo ====; curl -sL --max-time 180 -o povray-2.2.tgz "https://web.archive.org/web/20260417025352id_/http://www.povray.org/misc/oldversion.php?file=Official-2.2-Source-distribution/povray-2.2.tgz"; ls -la povray-2.2.tgz; head -c 100 povray-2.2.tgz | od -c | head -3
cd /app/src && mkdir -p t1 && tar -tzf povray-2.2.tgz | head -20; echo ===; tar -xzOf povray-2.2.tgz 2>/dev/null | head -c 400
cd /app/src && cp povray-2.2.tgz t1/x.gz && (cd t1 && gunzip -f x.gz && ls -la && head -c 600 x)

cd /app/src && curl -s --max-time 90 "http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Old-Versions*&fl=original,timestamp,statuscode&collapse=urlkey&limit=500" > cdx2.txt; wc -l cdx2.txt; grep -iE '2\.2' cdx2.txt | grep -iE 'tar|tgz|zip' | head -30

cd /app/src && curl -sL --max-time 120 "https://web.archive.org/web/20180330013809id_/http://www.povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Old-Versions/Official-2.2/?C=S;O=D" -o listing.html; grep -oE 'href="[^"]+"[^>]*>[^<]*' listing.html | head -40; echo ===; grep -oE '[0-9]{3,10}' listing.html | head -5

cd /app/src && python3 - <<'EOF' import re html = open('listing.html').read() rows = re.findall(r'(.*?)', html, re.S) for r in rows: cells = re.findall(r']*>(.*?)', r, re.S) cells = [re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', c).strip() for c in cells] if cells: print(' | '.join(cells)) EOF

cd /app/src && tr '\n' ' ' < listing.html | sed 's/<tr>/\n<tr>/g' | sed 's/<td[^>]*>/ | /g; s/<\/td>//g; s/<a href="[^"]*">//g; s/<[^>]*>//g' | grep -E 'TAR.Z|ZIP|LZH|SEA|EXE|DOC|README|WHATSNEW' | head -25

cd /app/src && awk 'BEGIN{RS="<tr>"} {gsub(/<a href="[^"]*">/,""); gsub(/<[^>]+>/,""); gsub(/[ \t]+/," "); if ($0 ~ /TAR\.Z|\.ZIP|\.LZH|\.SEA|\.EXE|README|WHATSNEW|KNOWNBUGS|POVINF/) print}' listing.html | head -25
cd /app/src && grep -oE 'href="[A-Z0-9._-]+">[A-Z0-9._-]+[^<]*[0-9K]+' listing.html | sed -E 's/href="//; s/">/ /; s/<\/a><\/td>//; s// /g; s/<\/td>//'
cd /app/src && for f in POVSCN.TAR.Z POVSRC.TAR.Z POVDOC.TAR.Z POVSCN.ZIP POVSRC.ZIP POVDOC.ZIP; do grep -o "$f.\{0,220\}" listing.html | grep -oE '[0-9]+K' | head -1 | tr -d '

cd /app/src && curl -sL --max-time 300 "https://web.archive.org/web/20180330013813id_/http://www.povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Old-Versions/Official-2.2/POVSRC.TAR.Z" -o POVSRC.TAR.Z && curl -sL --max-time 300 "https://web.archive.org/web/20180330013814id_/http://www.povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Old-Versions/Official-2.2/POVDOC.TAR.Z" -o POVDOC.TAR.Z && curl -sL --max-time 300 "https://web.archive.org/web/20180330013815id_/http://www.povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Old-Versions/Official-2.2/POVSCN.TAR.Z" -o POVSCN.TAR.Z && ls -la *.TAR.Z && for f in POVSRC.TAR.Z POVDOC.TAR.Z POVSCN.TAR.Z; do echo "== $f"; head -c 4 $f | od -An -c | head -1; done
which uncompress compress zcat; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y ncompress 2>&1 | tail -2; which uncompress

cd /app/src && for f in POVSRC POVDOC POVSCN; do uncompress -f $f.TAR.Z 2>/dev/null || cp $f.TAR.Z $f.TAR; done; ls -la *.TAR; echo ===SRC===; tar -tf POVSRC.TAR | head -30; echo ===DOC===; tar -tf POVDOC.TAR | head -30
cd /app/src && echo ===SRC-FULL===; tar -tf POVSRC.TAR; echo ===SCN===; tar -tf POVSCN.TAR | head -20
cd /app && mkdir -p povray-2.2 && tar -xf src/POVSRC.TAR -C povray-2.2 && tar -xf src/POVDOC.TAR -C povray-2.2 && tar -xf src/POVSCN.TAR -C povray-2.2 && ls -la povray-2.2/ && ls povray-2.2/povdoc/
cd /app/povray-2.2 && ls machine/unix/ && echo === && cat machine/unix/unix.mak
gcc --version | head -1; cd /app/povray-2.2 && mkdir -p build && cp source/* build/ && cp machine/unix/* build/ && cd build && cp gccconf.h config.h && cp unix.mak makefile && ls | head -30
cd /app/povray-2.2/build && grep -n 'unix_init_povray\|unix_exit_povray\|unix_read_command_line\|unix_display_image' *.c *.h | head -20; echo ===; grep -n 'ifdef\|ifndef\|define' unix.c | head -20
cd /app/povray-2.2/build && grep -n '^[a-z].*(\|^[A-Za-z_]* [a-z_]*(' gcc.c | head; echo ===; grep -nE '^(void|int|char|float|double)[a-z_ ]*\(' unix.c | head; echo ===; grep -n 'MACHINE' makefile
cd /app/povray-2.2/build && sed -i 's/MACHINE_OBJ\t= unix.\$(OBJ)/MACHINE_OBJ\t= gcc.$(OBJ)/' makefile && grep -n 'MACHINE_OBJ' makefile | head -2 && make 2>&1 | tail -8
cd /app/povray-2.2/build && grep -rn 'define FINISH_POVRAY\|define MAIN_RETURN_TYPE\|define PRINT_STATS' *.h | head
cd /app/povray-2.2/build && grep -rn 'MAIN_RETURN_STATEMENT' *.c *.h | head; echo ===; grep -n 'MAIN_RETURN_TYPE' povray.c | head
cd /app/povray-2.2/build && grep -rn 'FINISH_POVRAY' *.c | head; echo ===; grep -n 'STARTUP_POVRAY' povray.c | head -3; sed -n '118,130p' povray.c
cd /app/povray-2.2/build && make 2>&1 | grep -E 'error|warning: (redefinition|incompatible)|povray$|cc -o' | head; ls -la povray
cd /app/povray-2.2/build && make 2>&1 | tail -3; date; ls -la povray
cd /app/povray-2.2/build && grep -n 'EPSILON' frame.h gccconf.h config.h | head; echo ===; grep -n 'DBL_FORMAT_STRING\|HUGE_VAL' frame.h | head -5
cd /app/povray-2.2/build && grep -n "case 'P'" povray.c; sed -n "$(grep -n "case 'P'" povray.c | cut -d: -f1),+4p" povray.c
cd /app/povray-2.2/build && grep -n -i 'prompt' povray.c | head; echo ===; grep -c '' povray.c

cd /app/src && /usr/local/bin/povray +L/app/povray-2.2/povdoc/include +I/app/deps/illum1.pov +O/app/src/illum1.dump +W200 +H200 +A +P 2>&1 | tail -4; echo "EXIT: $?"; ls -la illum1.dump; head -c 100 illum1.dump | od -c | head -3
cd /app/src && rm -rf t1 listing.html cdx.txt cdx2.html sanity.log sanity2.log fixmatherr.awk illum1.tga illum1.dump README2.2 && ls -la /app/src/

cd /app/src && rm -f povray-2.2.tgz cdx2.txt && curl -sL --max-time 300 "https://web.archive.org/web/20180330013813id_/http://www.povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Old-Versions/Official-2.2/POVSRC.TAR.Z" -o POVSRC.TAR.Z && curl -sL --max-time 300 "https://web.archive.org/web/20180330013814id_/http://www.povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Old-Versions/Official-2.2/POVDOC.TAR.Z" -o POVDOC.TAR.Z && curl -sL --max-time 300 "https://web.archive.org/web/20180330013815id_/http://www.povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Old-Versions/Official-2.2/POVSCN.TAR.Z" -o POVSCN.TAR.Z && ls -la

echo "=== 1. /app/povray-2.2 structure ==="; ls /app/povray-2.2/; echo "=== 2. povdoc/include ==="; ls /app/povray-2.2/povdoc/include/ | head -5; echo "=== 3. /usr/local/bin/povray ==="; ls -la /usr/local/bin/povray; file /usr/local/bin/povray 2>/dev/null || head -c 4 /usr/local/bin/povray | od -An -c

md5sum /app/deps/illum1.pov; head -3 /app/deps/illum1.pov; echo ===; ls -la /app/; echo ===; ls -la /app/povray-2.2/build/povray /usr/local/bin/povray; md5sum /app/povray-2.2/build/povray /usr/local/bin/povray

cd /app/src && /usr/local/bin/povray +L/app/povray-2.2/povdoc/include +I/app/deps/illum1.pov +O/app/src/t.gif +W100 +H100 +fg +P 2>&1 | tail -2; echo "GIF EXIT: $?"; ls -la t.gif; head -c 6 t.gif; echo; /usr/local/bin/povray +L/app/povray-2.2/povdoc/include +I/app/deps/illum1.pov +O/app/src/t.raw +W100 +H100 +fr +P 2>&1 | tail -2; echo "RAW EXIT: $?"; ls -la t.raw* 2>/dev/null

cd /app/src && rm -f t.raw.red t.raw.grn t.raw.blu t.gif && ls -la /app/src/ && echo "=== FINAL VERIFICATION ===" && /usr/local/bin/povray +L/app/povray-2.2/povdoc/include +I/app/deps/illum1.pov +O/dev/null +P -V > /dev/null 2>&1; echo "sanity exit: $?" && test -x /usr/local/bin/povray && echo "binary: OK" && test -d /app/povray-2.2/povdoc/include && echo "includes: OK" && test -f /app/deps/illum1.pov && echo "illum1.pov: intact"
